apod.explanation: This NASA/ESA Hubble Space Telescope image, released November 5, 2026, shows the ancient globular cluster Messier 30, about 27,500 light-years away in the constellation Capricornus. The sparkling collection of stars is nearly as old as the universe itself — globular clusters are estimated at 11.5 to 13.5 billion years old — and the new portrait combines ultraviolet, visible and near-infrared observations from three Hubble programs, including a fifteen-year baseline tracking how different stellar populations move. Messier 30's unusual orbit hints it may have arrived with another galaxy rather than forming where it now sits.
apod.title: M30's Sparkling Stars

breaking.fact: Bitcoin fell as low as $67,652 on Friday, down more than 3.5% in 24 hours and 16% over the past month, slipping below its 200-week moving average near $68,000, before bouncing to around $69,500 after a softer-than-expected PPI reading.

breaking.fact: Bank of America now expects three consecutive quarter-point Fed rate hikes — December 2026, January 2027 and March 2027 — after October CPI came in hot, a step up from its earlier warning of a possible 50-basis-point December move.
breaking.headline: Bank of America now sees three straight Fed hikes

items.body: Iran's parliament speaker Mohammad Bagher Ghalibaf has said the strait will never return to pre-war conditions, and Tehran is still waiting for a U.S. answer to its seven conditions for reopening; attacks on shipping continued into November, with at least 10 ships hit in the first 10 days of the month after 37 attacks in October — the highest monthly tally — according to Washington Institute data. U.S. Central Command says it has turned away nearly 150 ships under its naval blockade of Iranian ports. On oil, Kpler's tracking shows Iranian crude loadings have been zero since late August — the first zero month since Kpler began tracking in 2013 — while non-Iranian crude is still moving, with Kpler putting direct Hormuz crude exports at about 7.3 million barrels a day in the week to October 28.
items.headline: Latest from the Strait

space.body: SpaceX's Starship Flight 15 is set for Friday evening from Starbase, with the FAA's air-traffic plan listing a window of 4:45–6:40 PM CT and the same time Saturday as backup, but no FAA launch license had been issued as of Friday morning. Road closures run 11 AM–11:30 PM; Booster 22 and Ship 42, both Block 3 vehicles, will attempt the first catch of both stages, with Ship 42 deploying 26 Starlink V3 satellites and a ship catch possible around 2:45 PM CT Saturday.
space.headline: FAA license still missing hours before Starship's first double catch

space.body: Brown University engineers solved the dead-layer problem that has limited multiferroic chips, showing bismuth ferrite films just a few atoms thick stay both ferroelectric and magnetic — a step toward ultra-low-power AI hardware — and stumbled onto a new form of magnetism, altermagnetism, along the way. The work was published in Nature Materials; it is a lab result, not yet a product.
space.headline: Brown engineers solve the 'dead layer' blocking ultra-low-power AI chips

space.body: Monash University scientists identified the protein Granzyme K as a driver of age-related damage in the heart, liver and kidneys, with levels rising sharply with age. The finding, published in Immunity, points to a possible target for slowing organ ageing.
space.headline: Monash scientists identify a protein driving age-related organ damage

space.body: Supernova SN 2026ahvu, in the galaxy NGC 1433 about 50 million light-years away, was discovered Nov 2 by ATLAS and confirmed as a young Type Ia explosion; it is still brightening and is expected to peak at magnitude 10.5–12.1 between Nov 18 and 23, tracked by DECam and Gemini South.
space.headline: Nearby supernova SN 2026ahvu still brightening, expected to peak Nov 18–23

weekInBrief.body: Producer prices rose 0.3% in October, below the 0.4% forecast and a sharp slowdown from September's upwardly revised 1.4% jump, but the annual rate climbed to 6.5%, the highest since November 2022. Food rose 1.3%, with fresh vegetables up 26.7%; core PPI rose 0.3% on the month and 5.0% over the year. It is the last inflation print before the Fed's December meeting.
weekInBrief.headline: October PPI rises 0.3%, but the annual rate hits a four-year high

weekInBrief.body: Cerebras shares jumped 18.19% in premarket trading after the AI chipmaker beat third-quarter expectations, with cloud revenue up 272%, and raised its full-year guidance.

weekInBrief.body: The 10-year Treasury yield is up nearly 30 basis points on the week to about 5.15%, its worst week since April, after hot CPI and PPI readings hardened expectations of a December Fed rate hike — pressuring gold and growth stocks.
